SELECT TK_NO ,'0' AS ZOKU ,HON_SIMEI AS SIMEI ,HON_KANA_SIMEI AS KANA_SIMEI ,GINKOU_CD ,COM_M_BANK.BANK_NM AS GINKOU_NM ,COM_M_BANK.SHITEN_CD ,COM_M_BANK.SHITEN_NM ,KOUZAMEIGI ,KOUZA_NO ,dbo.FN_CONVERT_WAREKI_TO_KNAME(TK_MEMBER.HON_SEINENGAPI) AS DISP_BIRTH ,? AS SHORI_TUKI-- 対象月検索条件に指定
FROM TK_MEMBER LEFT OUTER JOIN COM_M_BANK ON COM_M_BANK.BANK_CD = TK_MEMBER.GINKOU_CD AND COM_M_BANK.SHITEN_CD = TK_MEMBER.SHITEN_CD WHERE
(( DATEDIFF(YEAR, dbo.FN_CONVERT_WAREKI_TO_SEIREKI(TK_MEMBER.HON_SEINENGAPI), ? + '01' ) = 77 AND MONTH(dbo.FN_CONVERT_WAREKI_TO_SEIREKI(TK_MEMBER.HON_SEINENGAPI)) = MONTH( ? + '01' ) ) OR ( DATEDIFF(YEAR, dbo.FN_CONVERT_WAREKI_TO_SEIREKI(TK_MEMBER.HON_SEINENGAPI), ? + '01' ) = 88 AND MONTH(dbo.FN_CONVERT_WAREKI_TO_SEIREKI(TK_MEMBER.HON_SEINENGAPI)) = MONTH( ? + '01' ) ))
AND HON_TAISYOKU_CD NOT IN ('90', '91')
UNION ALL
SELECT TK_NO ,'1' AS ZOKU ,HAI_SIMEI ,HAI_KANA_SIMEI ,GINKOU_CD ,COM_M_BANK.BANK_NM AS GINKOU_NM ,COM_M_BANK.SHITEN_CD ,COM_M_BANK.SHITEN_NM ,KOUZAMEIGI ,KOUZA_NO ,dbo.FN_CONVERT_WAREKI_TO_KNAME(TK_MEMBER.HAI_SEINENGAPI) AS DISP_BIRTH ,? AS SHORI_TUKI FROM TK_MEMBER LEFT OUTER JOIN COM_M_BANK ON COM_M_BANK.BANK_CD = TK_MEMBER.GINKOU_CD AND COM_M_BANK.SHITEN_CD = TK_MEMBER.SHITEN_CD WHERE
(( DATEDIFF(YEAR, dbo.FN_CONVERT_WAREKI_TO_SEIREKI(TK_MEMBER.HAI_SEINENGAPI), ? + '01' ) = 77 AND MONTH(dbo.FN_CONVERT_WAREKI_TO_SEIREKI(TK_MEMBER.HAI_SEINENGAPI)) = MONTH( ? + '01' ) ) OR ( DATEDIFF(YEAR, dbo.FN_CONVERT_WAREKI_TO_SEIREKI(TK_MEMBER.HAI_SEINENGAPI), ? + '01' ) = 88 AND MONTH(dbo.FN_CONVERT_WAREKI_TO_SEIREKI(TK_MEMBER.HAI_SEINENGAPI)) = MONTH( ? + '01' ) ))
AND HAI_TAISYOKU_CD NOT IN ('90', '91')
